title: Tuition Payment Plan
text: Students who cannot pay the full tuition balance by the due date may request a payment plan before the tuition deadline. The request is submitted through the student billing portal. The first installment is due when the plan is activated. Late requests may be reviewed individually, but approval is not guaranteed. Students should contact Student Accounts if a payment is missing or a plan does not appear correctly.

title: Internship Registration Checklist
text: Before internship registration, students must have an approved internship site and a confirmed site supervisor. The registration packet should include supervisor contact information, learning objectives, expected weekly hours, and the planned start and end dates. The program office reviews the packet before enrollment. Students should not begin counting internship hours until the required approval and registration steps are complete.

title: Scholarship Appeal Instructions
text: A scholarship appeal should include a signed appeal form, a short explanation describing the changed circumstances, and supporting documentation. Examples of supporting documents may include financial records or other evidence relevant to the appeal. Appeals submitted after the priority deadline may still be reviewed, but processing can take longer. Students should keep copies of all materials submitted with the appeal.

title: VPN Troubleshooting
text: If VPN access fails, first confirm that the device has an internet connection and that multi-factor authentication is working. Update the VPN client, restart the device, and try the connection again. If the problem continues, record the error message and contact the service desk. Students working remotely should test VPN access before an important class, meeting, or deadline.

title: Course Add and Drop
text: Students may add or drop courses through the registration system during the published schedule adjustment period. After that period, changes may require additional approval and may follow withdrawal rules instead of normal drop rules. Students should review academic and financial consequences before changing enrollment. Questions about registration holds should be directed to the office responsible for the hold.

title: Library Research Help
text: Students can request research help from the library for database searching, source evaluation, citation management, and research strategy. Appointments may be available in person or online. For a productive appointment, students should bring the assignment instructions, their research question, and examples of searches they have already tried. The library can help improve a search process but does not complete the assignment for the student.

title: Graduate Advising Preparation
text: Before an advising appointment, graduate students should review their degree requirements, current registration, completed courses, and remaining requirements. Students should prepare questions about course planning, prerequisites, internships, or graduation timing. Bringing an updated degree plan helps the advisor identify possible scheduling problems. Students should also mention any registration holds or expected changes in enrollment.

title: Career Services Appointments
text: Career Services offers appointments for resume review, interview preparation, internship searches, and job-search planning. Students should upload or bring a current resume when requesting resume feedback. For interview practice, students should bring the job description when possible. Career advisors can help students prepare application materials and search strategies, but employers make final hiring decisions.

title: Password Reset and MFA
text: Students who forget their password should use the account recovery page before contacting support. After a password change, some devices may continue using an old saved password and require an update. Multi-factor authentication should also be checked if login attempts continue to fail. If account recovery does not work, students should contact the service desk and be ready to verify their identity.

title: Graduation Application
text: Students planning to graduate should submit the graduation application by the published deadline for the intended term. Before applying, students should review remaining degree requirements and confirm that their name and contact information are correct. Missing requirements can delay graduation clearance. Students should contact their academic program if their degree audit does not match the courses or requirements they expect.
